sn35.151:1.1: The Vinaya establishes that a newly ordained monastic should live in dependence on a mentor (_uppajjhāya_) and/or a “tutor” (_ācariya_) as a “resident pupil” (_antevāsi_) for at least the first five years. If they considered qualified at that point they may be released from dependence. Here the Buddha plays with this idea, inverting the standard meaning.
